title: Mai-Men-Dong decoction alleviates radiation-induced lung injury by regulating ferroptosis through modulation of the STAT6/p53/SLC7A11 axis.
authors: Li, Jing; Qu, Liyuan; Chen, Xiangdong; Kang, Junli; Du, Haifang; Zhu, Dequan; Fan, Qian; Zhong, Zhiyong; Sun, Dongmei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药麦门冬汤通过STAT6/p53/SLC7A11轴调控铁死亡缓解放射性肺损伤，虽含分子对接与MD模拟，但核心是药理机制而非TF-DNA互作建模，仅方法可部分借鉴。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Mai-Men-Dong decoction (MMDD), a classical prescription in traditional Chinese medicine (TCM), has demonstrated therapeutic effects against pneumonia, pulmonary fibrosis, pulmonary tuberculosis, and radiation-induced lung injury (RILI). However, the anti-RILI mechanisms and active constituents of MMDD remain unclear. AIMS OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to systematically elucidate the therapeutic mechanisms and bioactive compounds of MMDD in alleviating RILI, with a particular emphasis on its potential role in regulating ferroptosis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: A comprehensive experimental strategy was employed. First, the intrinsic components of MMDD and its blood-absorbed prototype compounds were identified using Ultra-Performance Liquid Chromatography-Q-Orbitrap Mass Spectrometry (UPLC-Q-Orbitrap MS). The anti-RILI efficacy of MMDD was then evaluated in an X-ray-induced mouse model through histological (Hematoxylin and Eosin staining (H&E) and Masson staining) and biochemical (interleukin-6 (IL-6) and transforming growth factor-beta1 (TGF-beta1) levels) analyses. Subsequently, potential targets and pathways were predicted by integrating transcriptomic analysis and network pharmacology analysis. Potential active components were further screened via molecular docking, with key complexes subsequently assessed by molecular dynamics (MD) simulation. Finally, the involvement of the STAT6/p53/SLC7A11 axis and ferroptosis was validated through in vivo experiments. RESULTS: A total of 209 and 152 intrinsic components, were identified under the positive and negative ion modes, respectively, along with 18 prototype compounds absorbed into the blood. MMDD administration significantly improved lung tissue injury, reduced collagen deposition, and decreased IL-6 and TGF-beta1 levels in RILI mice. Integrated analyses revealed 737 differentially expressed genes and 182 overlapping targets, implicating key pathways such as the p53, IL-17, and JAK-STAT signaling pathways. Molecular docking identified several compounds, including methylophiopogonanone A and B, as potential active components. MD simulation substantiated the stable binding of methylophiopogonanone A to STAT6. Importantly, in vivo validation demonstrated that MMDD inhibited ferroptosis, as evidenced by the normalization of ferroptosis-related markers (Fe(2+), glutathione (GSH), malondialdehyde (MDA), and 4-hydroxynonenal (4-HNE)) and the regulation of the STAT6/p53/SLC7A11 signaling axis. CONCLUSION: MMDD ameliorates RILI through multi-component, multi-target, and multi-pathway mechanisms. This study is the first to demonstrate that MMDD regulates ferroptosis associated with modulation of the STAT6/p53/SLC7A11 axis, providing a modern pharmacological basis for its traditional clinical use.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：麦门冬汤（MMDD）作为传统中药（TCM）中的经典方剂，已显示出对肺炎、肺纤维化、肺结核及放射性肺损伤（RILI）的治疗效果。然而，MMDD抗RILI的作用机制及活性成分仍不明确。研究目的：本研究旨在系统阐明MMDD缓解RILI的治疗机制及生物活性化合物，特别关注其在调控铁死亡（ferroptosis）中的潜在作用。材料与方法：采用综合实验策略。首先，利用超高效液相色谱-Q-Orbitrap质谱联用（UPLC-Q-Orbitrap MS）鉴定MMDD的内在成分及其血中吸收的原型化合物。随后，在X射线诱导的小鼠模型中，通过组织学（苏木精-伊红染色（H&E）和Masson染色）及生化（白细胞介素-6（IL-6）和转化生长因子-β1（TGF-β1）水平）分析评估MMDD的抗RILI疗效。接着，整合转录组学分析和网络药理学分析预测潜在靶点及通路。通过分子对接进一步筛选潜在活性成分，关键复合物随后通过分子动力学（MD）模拟评估。最后，通过体内实验验证STAT6/p53/SLC7A11轴及铁死亡的参与。结果：在正离子和负离子模式下分别鉴定出209种和152种内在成分，以及18种吸收入血的原型化合物。MMDD给药显著改善RILI小鼠的肺组织损伤，减少胶原沉积，并降低IL-6和TGF-β1水平。整合分析揭示737个差异表达基因和182个重叠靶点，涉及p53、IL-17和JAK-STAT等关键信号通路。分子对接鉴定出多种化合物，包括甲基麦冬黄烷酮A和B，作为潜在活性成分。MD模拟证实甲基麦冬黄烷酮A与STAT6的稳定结合。重要的是，体内验证表明MMDD抑制铁死亡，证据为铁死亡相关标志物（Fe(2+)、谷胱甘肽（GSH）、丙二醛（MDA）和4-羟基壬烯醛（4-HNE））的正常化及STAT6/p53/SLC7A11信号轴的调控。结论：MMDD通过多成分、多靶点、多通路机制改善RILI。本研究首次证明MMDD通过调控STAT6/p53/SLC7A11轴相关铁死亡发挥作用，为其传统临床应用提供了现代药理学基础。
